With a no-load speed ranging from 10,000 to 30,000 RPM and 6-speed adjustment settings, it adapts seamlessly to a wide variety of working conditions and materials. The maximum milling cutter diameter of Φ6.35mm makes it suitable for precise trimming tasks. A built-in flashing alarm system alerts you to any malfunctions, keeping your work safe and uninterrupted. The tool is compatible with multiple optional bases for added versatility and can be connected to a dust collection system for a cleaner, dust-free working environment. With a net weight of just 2.6kg (tool only), it is lightweight and easy to handle for extended use on site.
